basics.name: Eskil Gaasø Indrestrand
basics.label: PhD Candidate
basics.summary: PhD Candidate at the Department of Sociology and Political Science, NTNU.

work.name: NTNU, Department of Sociology and Political Science
work.summary: My doctoral project focuses on how large language models and AI are implemented in central government.
highlights: Member of the research groups Public Policy and Administration; Technology and Social Change; and EVPOC (Elections, Values, and Political Communication).
Taught the course POL2017 (Specialization in Political Science: Public Policy and Administration).
Previously served as lecturer in the teacher education programme (SAM1020, Citizenship Education).
Elected and appointed roles: Department Board (2025-2026); Faculty Board, Programme Council for PhD Candidates at SU, Research Committee (2026-2027); NTNU Board (2026-2027).
Reviewer for Public Management Review and International Journal of Public Administration.
Member of the local organizing committee for the International Research Society in Public Management (IRSPM) 2027 conference in Trondheim (2026-2027).
Member of NORA HS, the Norwegian AI Research School for Humanities and Society (until 2028).
Member of Digit, The Norwegian Research School on Digitalization, Culture, and Society (2026-2028).

work.name: ISS, NTNU (Department of Sociology and Political Science, SU Faculty)
work.summary: Part of the teaching staff in statistics at the master's and PhD levels at the SU faculty (course SOS3003).
highlights: Led 18 seminars in applied statistics (linear and logistic regression) using STATA.
Increased student attendance and received strong anonymous evaluations.
Coordinated teaching with two professors and other course staff, revising the course for the following year.
